A little space to breathe. A little time to feel like yourself again.

Bella Vista Oasis Spa began as part of the Bella Vista estate in 2021. Created around relaxation, therapeutic treatments, and private wellness experiences, it is a place to pause alone or share a moment of calm with the people closest to you.

GOOD TO KNOW

Before you arrive.

OPEN DAILY

1:00 PM — 9:00 PM

Give yourself time

Please arrive 15 minutes early, so your visit can begin unhurried.

When plans change

Please cancel or reschedule at least six hours before your appointment.

Your wellbeing comes first

Tell the spa about relevant medical conditions, injuries, or pregnancy before choosing a service.

Keeping the quiet

Please keep voices low. A 30-minute cleaning gap follows each session.
